choices.A: Every category must be carried out once
choices.B: Several categories of ways are mutually exclusive, and completing the task requires choosing a way from just one category
choices.C: Each step must be followed by the next step
choices.D: A way may belong to two categories simultaneously, and the counts are still added

question: In which situation does the addition principle of counting apply?
solution: The categories must be mutually exclusive, and completing a way from any one category completes the task. When the categories overlap, their counts cannot be added directly.
